details:
Hi! I'd really love to see a way to share screenshots or even some kind of screenshare attached to my avatar, rather than a twitch stream on a custom world. I've seen Tupper or someone directly attached to VRC staff saying it isn't possible... I'm still going to post this to see what community reception is on the forum and if there's some workaround possible.

I don't really care if it's low res and high latency, I just want to be able to comfortably work on homework or play games while showing my friends without needing discord in the middle.

I know the infrastructure and performance behind that is a challenge. Maybe limit the number of screens you can watch at a time, and anyone else just gets a gray/blue translucent plane floating where their screen would be.

At least SOMETHING other than "hey I have an OVR overlay in front of me and I'm doing work" while staring out into space with my avatar's hands goofily at my side while my hands are on my keyboard.

I almost wonder if there's a way to save dev work by having some kind of overlay that directly links with discord, communicating avatar position and screens being shared. Maybe that's best for an app that isn't VRC, whichever the case may be I just wanted to put that out there.

Thanks!
title: Avatar attached screenshot and screenshare
